properties.name: numSamples
properties.description: a progressive renderer's ('quality') samples per pixel since the last change, or its sample limit (sampleLimit or convergedSamplesPerPixel) once every pixel has converged, unless sampleLimit is 0 (VisRTX's property, which hdAnari reads and compares with sampleLimit); not reported for other renderers

parameters.name: allowInvalidMaterials
parameters.description: show surfaces with invalid materials

parameters.name: invalidMaterialColor
parameters.description: color to identify surfaces with invalid materials

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: optional object name

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: visualization modes (most for debugging)

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: what camera rays that miss see: a color or an image

parameters.name: ambientColor
parameters.description: ambient light color (not read by this renderer)

parameters.name: ambientRadiance
parameters.description: the eye light's ambient term, read only with ignoreAmbientLighting false

parameters.name: ignoreAmbientLighting
parameters.description: ignore 'ambientRadiance' and 'ambientColor' parameters on the renderer

parameters.name: eyeLightBlendRatio
parameters.description: how much eye lighting factor should be used in default render mode

parameters.name: volumeSamplingRate
parameters.description: sampling rate of volumes when ray marching

parameters.name: ambientOcclusion
parameters.description: darken the first visible surface by screen-space ambient occlusion in the default render mode

parameters.name: ambientOcclusionRadius
parameters.description: world-space distance within which geometry occludes; 0 uses 3 percent of the world bounds diagonal, and so does a negative value, which is clamped to 0 without a warning

parameters.name: ambientOcclusionEstimator
parameters.description: form of the occlusion estimator: g3d (G3D's high-quality SAO) or sao (the SAO paper's, with its linear intensity set to the radius so that it doesn't depend on the scene's units)

parameters.name: ambientOcclusionIntensity
parameters.description: exponent of the occlusion factor: above 1 darkens, below 1 lightens, 0 gives an occlusion factor of 1

parameters.name: ambientOcclusionBlurPasses
parameters.description: passes of the depth-aware blur of the occlusion factor: the first removes the noise of its 4x4 rotation pattern, each further pass (an a-trous pass with twice the previous stride) smooths bands near contacts; values outside [1, 5] are clamped without a warning

parameters.name: taskGrainSizeWidth
parameters.description: grain size of the render task along the width of the frame

parameters.name: taskGrainSizeHeight
parameters.description: grain size of the render task along the height of the frame

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: optional object name

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'default' path traces; the others show one value of the shading context at the pixel center's first visible surface, unscaled (for debugging)

parameters.name: pixelSamples
parameters.description: paths traced per pixel by each render

parameters.name: maxBounces
parameters.description: path vertices that scatter after the first; the ray leaving the last one only gathers what it sees

parameters.name: randomNumberSeed
parameters.description: seed of the sample generator (Typhoon's OpenQMC Sobol sampler); -1 uses a fixed default, the seed of scene frame 0

parameters.name: lightSamplesPerHit
parameters.description: stratified samples of every light at each path vertex (next-event estimation)

parameters.name: minBouncesBeforeRR
parameters.description: path vertices before Russian roulette may end a path

parameters.name: fireflyClampThreshold
parameters.description: largest luminance of one light sample and of one contribution to a path; 0 or less doesn't clamp

parameters.name: disableShadows
parameters.description: light every path vertex as if nothing blocked the lights

parameters.name: enableCaustics
parameters.description: follow caustic paths (a specular or refracted sample after a diffuse-like event); off, caustic lobes are pruned there and shadow rays pass straight through thick transparent surfaces

parameters.name: causticsClampThreshold
parameters.description: largest luminance of one contribution to a caustic path, before the firefly clamp; 0 or less doesn't clamp

parameters.name: nativeMaterials
parameters.description: shade matte and most physicallyBased materials natively in ISPC; false shades them through their MaterialXCpp graphs in C++, as every other material, which renders the same images (to rounding for matte) more slowly (to validate one against the other)

parameters.name: convergedSamplesPerPixel
parameters.description: samples per pixel at which renders stop refining the image (Typhoon's ty:convergedSamplesPerPixel; reached at whole renders of pixelSamples) unless sampleLimit is set; also scales ray differentials to the footprint of one of that many samples

parameters.name: sampleLimit
parameters.description: VisRTX's name for convergedSamplesPerPixel, which hdAnari reads: if set, the samples per pixel at which renders stop refining the image, and the ray differentials' scale, whatever convergedSamplesPerPixel says (a convergedSamplesPerPixel other than 256 and other than it warns); unset, convergedSamplesPerPixel's; 0 stops only once every pixel has converged, with convergedSamplesPerPixel's differentials

parameters.name: adaptiveThreshold
parameters.description: adaptive sampling: a pixel stops taking samples once the variance of its mean is at most 1e-6 plus this times its squared mean in every colour channel (Typhoon's ty:adaptiveThreshold; 0.01 is about a 10% standard error)

parameters.name: minSamplesBeforeAdaptive
parameters.description: adaptive sampling: samples a pixel takes before it may stop (Typhoon's ty:minSamplesBeforeAdaptive); a negative value, or one at least a positive sample limit (sampleLimit or convergedSamplesPerPixel), turns adaptive sampling off

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: what camera rays that miss see: a color or an image; it doesn't light the scene

parameters.name: ambientColor
parameters.description: ambient light color: a constant dome of this color times ambientRadiance that lights the scene; camera rays don't see it

parameters.name: ambientRadiance
parameters.description: the amount of light emitted by a point on the ambient light source in a direction, in W/sr/m^2

parameters.name: taskGrainSizeWidth
parameters.description: grain size of the render task along the width of the frame

parameters.name: taskGrainSizeHeight
parameters.description: grain size of the render task along the height of the frame
